**tuna-fonts 0.2.3**: fixes for watched folders, from the first bug reports. If you have 0.2.1 or 0.2.2, the app will offer it when you open it.

### Fixed
- **"Stop watching" froze the app** ([#1](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/issues/1)). With a big folder, the first read takes a while, and stopping it in the meantime left the window "Not Responding". It now happens in the background.
- **A watched folder could look empty.** It only listed the families that were in that folder alone, so fonts you also had installed were left out, which is most of them in a font collection. Now it shows every font inside it, subfolders included (Fonts / Foundry / Family works fine). While the first read is going on, it says so instead of looking empty.
- **Office fonts count as system fonts again.** Since 0.2.1, the fonts that come with Office (Agency, Bodoni, Gill Sans, Rockwell...) showed up as yours, so the list jumped from a few dozen fonts to well over a hundred. They're locked and hidden again, like the Windows ones; fonts you installed yourself for all users still show up.

### Small things
- **Click a file path** in a font's page to see it in File Explorer.
- **Favorites** doesn't show in the sidebar until you have at least one.

### Downloads
- **`tuna-fonts_0.2.3_x64-setup.exe`**: installer (per user, no admin rights needed). Updates itself.
- **`tuna-fonts_0.2.3_x64-portable.zip`**: portable version; unzip and run `tuna-fonts.exe`.

Windows 10/11, 64-bit. **Not code-signed**, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time: *More info → Run anyway*.

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/issues/new/choose).

---

**En español:** la 0.2.3 arregla las carpetas vigiladas. «Dejar de vigilar» ya no cuelga la app mientras todavía lee una carpeta grande ([#1](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/issues/1)). Una carpeta vigilada enseña todas sus fuentes, también las de subcarpetas y las que ya tienes instaladas, y mientras lee lo dice en vez de parecer vacía. Las fuentes de Office vuelven a contar como del sistema (con candado y ocultas); las que instalaste tú para todos los usuarios siguen saliendo. Además, un clic en la ruta de un archivo de la ficha lo enseña en el Explorador, y Favoritas no sale en la barra lateral hasta que tienes alguna.
